declarations.name: Theorem R1. Universal realization of return transport by inner braids
declarations.scope: For every minimal polynomial quotient, normalized return transport with free generators is a positive peripheral substitution preserving their ordered product. Artin's actual Theorem16 realizes it as an inner braid independently of fibre degree. The exact substitution cocycle supplies the quotient-stabilizer subgroup of B_M; full inner braid availability is not asserted.

declarations.name: Corollary R2. The inner component and its monodromy
declarations.scope: The full inner braid orbit is an invariant of the original component preserving the stated blocks. Its literal generated group equals the group induced on root block zero by its setwise stabilizer in the original monodromy group. This is necessary and is not asserted sufficient.

declarations.name: Lemma R3. The four-sheet return fibres
declarations.scope: For block size4, the complete return budget list is one4cycle, C3+T, DT+T or T+T+T. The first three cases have one root-phase orbit and therefore no additional gluing components above a decorated quotient component. Three transpositions give16 literal returns and four free root-phase orbits.

declarations.name: Theorem R4. A complete \(A_4\) criterion for four-sheet gluing
declarations.scope: For every quotient degree and branch count, all block-size4 gluing components are determined by an explicit four-state edge action in A4 in the triple-T sector and by the decoration in all other sectors. The complete Schreier subgroup H_Y has point orbit pattern1+1+1+1,2+2,1+3 or4; an h-point orbit gives4h|Y| literal tuples. Deck rotations and the canonical-divisor filter are retained. This is a uniform four-state criterion over the decorated quotient graph, not an assertion of connectivity or a classification for b>=5.

declarations.name: Theorem R5. Every inner component obstruction survives a cyclic outer lift
declarations.scope: Every degree-b polynomial inner tuple with literal group J has a cyclic outer lift of degree bd for each d>=2, with passport(d^b) plus the inner factors extended by fixed points, literal group the standard J wr C_d, and the original inner tuple after deleting identity returns. Distinct full inner components stay distinct. Hence every d>=2 gives at least six components with the same standard A11 wr C_d for passport(d^11),(3^2 1^(11d-6)),(3^3 1^(11d-9)); for odd d the standard spin is+1. This is not a complete list of that passport's components.

declarations.name: Proposition R6. All four component patterns occur
declarations.scope: All four A4 point-orbit patterns occur in explicit complete finite quotient sectors. For the degree16 passport(2^5 1^6)^3, its whole block-size4 sector has2048 literal tuples in four components256,256,768,768, deck order1 and absolute sizes16,16,48,48.
